description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeService class responsible for managing employee-related operations within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes methods for CRUD operations, event dispatching, subordinate management, and validation of employee data. The class interacts with data access objects, other services, and event mechanisms to provide a comprehensive employee management service.

classes.name: EmployeeService
classes.description: Service class providing employee management functionalities, including CRUD, hierarchy, event dispatching, validation, and data normalization.

methods.name: getEmployeeDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the EmployeeDao instance used for data persistence operations.

methods.name: setEmployeeDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeDao dependency.

methods.name: getEmployeeEventService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the EmployeeEventService instance for event management.

methods.name: getEmployeeTerminationService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the EmployeeTerminationService instance.

methods.name: getIDGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the IDGeneratorService instance.

methods.name: getEmployeeList
methods.description: Fetches a list of employees based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Counts employees matching the search filter criteria.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Persists an employee object and dispatches an EmployeeSavedEvent.

methods.name: saveNewEmployee
methods.description: Generates a new ID and saves a new employee record.

methods.name: dispatchAddEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Dispatches events related to adding a new employee.

methods.name: updateEmployeePersonalDetails
methods.description: Updates employee personal details and triggers related events.

methods.name: updateEmployeeJobDetails
methods.description: Updates employee job details and triggers related events.

methods.name: dispatchJoinedDateChangedEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event indicating an employee's joining date has changed.

methods.name: getEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an Employee entity by employee number.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployees
methods.description: Returns total number of employees, optionally including terminated employees.

methods.name: getSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId
methods.description: Returns list of subordinate employee numbers under a supervisor, with support for hierarchical chain and depth limits.

methods.name: getSubordinateList
methods.description: Returns list of subordinate Employee entities for a supervisor, considering hierarchy and termination status.

methods.name: isSupervisor
methods.description: Checks if a given employee is a supervisor.

methods.name: deleteEmployees
methods.description: Deletes employees by their employee numbers and dispatches deletion event.

methods.name: getSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId
methods.description: Returns list of supervisor employee numbers for a given subordinate, considering hierarchical chain and depth.

methods.name: getEmployeeAsArray
methods.description: Returns employee data as an array suitable for normalization or API responses.

methods.name: getAvailableEmployeesForWorkShift
methods.description: Fetches employees available for work shifts based on search criteria.

methods.name: getUndeletableEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns employee numbers that cannot be deleted for system or admin reasons.

methods.name: isUniqueEmail
methods.description: Validates email uniqueness considering current employee email.

methods.name: isUniqueEmployeeId
methods.description: Validates employee ID uniqueness considering current employee ID.
